messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty: [SEV2] runtime crashloop detected in pool 'pool-rl-3' — multiple container restarts across nodes. Affected service: runtime-engine. Paging @sara_k. Link: https://internal.incidents/3239990000 :rotating_light:

sara_k: ack — joining. can someone paste `kubectl get pods -n runtime -o wide` for pool-rl-3?

matt_l: paste: `runtime-engine-abcde-0    CrashLoopBackOff   6   10m   10.0.1.17   gpu-node-17   redwood/runtime:v2.3`
logs show repeated crash: `Segmentation fault (core dumped)` from fused_attn_trt.so

vikram_p: quick triage — segfault looks like an invalid read in TRT fused kernel after the `trt-quant-opt` rollout earlier this morning. hypothesis: memory fragmentation + driver/kernel mismatch. plan: rollback TRT variant for affected replicas and disable TRT runtime as emergency fallback.

sara_k: understood. initiating cordon on gpu-node-17 to stop new pods landing there: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` :white_check_mark:

lee_c: cordon done. next step drain to surface core dumps: `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` (evicting runtime pods).

matt_l: deployed emergency toggle to force CPU runtime: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime DISABLE_TRT=true --namespace=runtime` — rollout triggered, restarting pods.

incident-bot: Action recorded: DISABLE_TRT=true set on deployment/runtime. Rollout in progress. Notifying status page and affected customers.

sara_k: monitoring metrics — error rate (5xx) dropped from ~18% to ~3% within 90s after the toggle. Affected large-context requests still showing some failures while older nodes drain.

vikram_p: collecting artifacts: copying coredump and `dmesg` from gpu-node-17, running: `gdb --batch -ex 'bt full' -ex 'quit' /opt/runtime/bin/engine core.1234` and `sudo journalctl -k | tail -n200 > /tmp/node17-kern.log` — attaching to the incident thread.

matt_l: workaround note for SRE: if you see `nvmap: invalid address` or `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` in logs, kill the pod and let HPA/autoscaler reschedule; prefer nodes with driver 535.x for now. Will open infra ticket for driver validation.

sara_k: customer impact summary for status page: ~5% of total requests returned 502s during peak window (12:10–12:18 UTC). Primary impact: Dedicated customers in us-west-2 on large-context workloads. Ops: contact list updated and Customer Success pinged.

lee_c: queued hotfix build `runtime:v2.3.1-hotfix` (removes problematic fused kernel path) for CI, will promote to canary once tests pass.

vikram_p: handing off next 30m of oncall to me for follow-up and postmortem lead. adding runbook pointer: /runbooks/runtime-segfaults and adding reproducible inputs.

pagerduty: Reminder: next oncall is vikram_p in 30m. :bell:

sara_k: thanks team — keeping the incident open until hotfix promoted and affected nodes reprovisioned. :thumbsup:
